Episode 165. After the Shock (4)
On March 4, 1803, about ten days had passed since the Sword Garden battle, dubbed 'The Great Battle' by the Saints.
The world was trembling in fear, unparalleled to any other time.

Despite only three years having passed since a formal armistice agreement of five years was signed, it was shocking in itself that large forces launched a full-scale attack on Huphester overnight without any prior warning.
The fact that the real winner of that battle was Runcandel, and that Runcandel colluded with chaos to contaminate the entire Huphester, drove the world into even greater fear.

(Reveal that Runcandel's family head Rosa Runcandel and Chiron Runcandel died in the Black Sea. The entity that killed the half-gods is the King of the Black Sea, implying that there are several beings like Gliek of the Sword Emperor's Temple left...)

(The Black Leopard, as the new owner of Runcandel, announced that he would continue the maintenance of the previous generation and subdue the Kings of the Black Sea. However, he greatly emphasized that unifying the entire world is the top priority before that.)
(Jin Runcandel formed an alliance with Zipfel and Kinzelo and attempted rebellion. Rosa Runcandel has revoked his rider qualifications and defined him as an enemy of the family...)
(Is the world in turmoil, is the thousand-year war ending?)
There were special bulletins pouring out every day.
Huphester's newsletters were particularly active.
The content was all about praising Rosa and branding Jin as a traitor, but Jin rather felt relieved at such black propaganda and incitement.
"It seems that Rosa does not intend to eliminate all humans in the world immediately. Inciting means that she is conscious of public opinion."
Jin's colleagues nodded at his words.
"As you say, it seems Rosa doesn't intend to make all humans in the world her enemy. After all, what use is it to be the only loser in the world if there's no one to rule?"

"It may not be about ruling but about effectively sourcing sacrifices, Lord Quikantel. When she was utilizing that enormous black line and the power of chaos that day, perhaps all the residents of Calron may have been used as sacrifices. She is a person who wouldn't care if everyone else but Runcandel died."
"The ruler of a destroyed world... then gathering sacrifices, humans, is it to prepare for the next fight against us and Zipfel and Kinzelo?"
"That could be one reason, but..."
Jin's gaze fell on the newsletter. The part that said 'Rosa will continue Chiron's maintenance'.
"The remaining Kings of the Black Sea. Rosa's statement that she will subjugate them is probably true. They are the ones who pose the biggest threat to Runcandel right now."
The five Kings of the Black Sea.

Jin didn't know the exact number, but he was aware that they have been seeking revenge since the Gliek incident. Along with the assumption that Chiron's obsession with the Black Sea was because of them.
"Could the kings of the Black Sea also be in alliance with the Prophet?"
"That's possible. We need to confirm whether the Prophet is truly a witch and what kind of relationship the first chaos witch has with the kings of the Black Sea."
At that moment, Jet and Gilly arrived at the meeting room.
"Master, ships from Zipfel and Kinzelo have entered our territory."
At three o'clock in the afternoon, the two great powers had come to Tikan for negotiations.
"I hope they bring useful information. Did they keep the agreement?"

"Yes, my lord. Both forces only brought one flagship each. There's no excessive request for entry, and only a few are disembarking from the sea. Four people from Zipfel, and three from Kinzelo. They seem really nervous, coming to our headquarters with such small numbers and without any escorts."
Just three years ago, a few key figures from both powers would not have felt threatened.
But now, they had a lot at stake if they wanted to challenge Tikan. Not only because Tikan's overall power had increased, but mainly because of Jin.
"They must be feeling urgent. We are in the same boat though."
Jin and his party left the mansion and headed to the first floor of Tikan. Soon, they came face to face with the leaders of each power.
Upon seeing them, Jin frowned in disappointment.
"Why did you guys come? I distinctly requested for the leaders to come."
Four people from Zipfel took off their robes.
Octavia, Hedo, Sandra, and a person Jin had never met in this life.
'Ronil Zipfel...'
The eldest son of Kelliark.

In his previous life, he was known as the second most talented among the second generation of Zipfel, after Veradin. The nobles considered him as a figure who didn't shine as much because he was overshadowed by Veradin and Luna.
'So he was a hidden power within Zipfel, like Octavia.'
Strictly speaking, Ronil was more of an 'unknown power' rather than a hidden one.
Jin didn't know this in his previous life, but even then, the leaders of each house considered Ronil a pivotal figure.
While being intentionally dismissive, Jin momentarily noticed the unusually quiet Sandra. Unlike her usual self, she was staring at Jin without any emotion.
'Did she learn to distinguish public from private affairs? I hope it's not the result of exposure to some Zipfel experiment.'
Ronil bowed his head slightly.
"My father's illness has worsened so I came as a representative with the authority of the first horse tower. I hope the 12th Knight of Runcandel will understand."
Although he came out first, Ronil was not superior to Octavia. Jin realized that Ronil was dealing with the awkward situation instead of Octavia.
"Jin, our chief came in person! Haha, we would appreciate some compliments!"
With a squeak, Margiella spoke, pulling her wheelchair. As she said, Kinzelo was visited by Orgal and Bishkel, and Margiella.
Jin did not respond, instead meeting Orgal's gaze.
"You seem quite self-satisfied, Chief. Like someone who owes me."
"Did it seem that way? My aid in the Sword Garden that day was a choice for everyone's benefit. I didn't intend to receive a special reward."
"That's a relief."
"But, Jin Runcandel, you seem to have a delicate side. Did you address me as 'Chief' thinking that Zipfel wouldn't know my identity?"
"Why would I? The people who fabricated your history wouldn't be unaware of the name Orgal."
-If he's such a significant figure, perhaps even Zipfel themselves might not know that they've fabricated Orgal's history.
-Even if Zipfel knew, it's possible the information didn't trickle down to Myron.
The conversation he had with his colleagues after learning about the Chief's identity for the first time.
Since then, Jin had been wondering. Did Zipfel actually know about the historical manipulation they conducted on Orgal, and if so, what was the reason for this manipulation?
From Jin's perspective, it was a bizarre scene.
The manipulator of history and those manipulated were in the same place.
"Moreover, weren't Kinzelo and Zipfel quite friendly during my time as a reserve knight?"
"We were, until you killed Andrei Zipfel and destroyed the initial Demon Stone. But Jin, Zipfel only recently discovered my name. A little later than when you did."
"So, the world-renowned Zipfel had been dealing with someone they didn't even know for so long."
"If we can provide what the other needs, that's all that matters. But, are we going to diverge from the purpose of this meeting as soon as we arrive?"
The purpose of the meeting is obviously a temporary alliance. To face Rosa of Runcandel.
"Well, is it really a divergence?"
Jin smiled.

"Orgal, I presume the more you are freed from historical manipulation, the stronger you'll become. So to confront Rosa, the public enemy, isn't it time for Zipfel to undo your historical manipulation?"
He didn't truly believe this. He merely threw out the suggestion to stir things up.
At that, Octavia, who had been suppressing her emotions all along, furrowed her brows.
"12th Knight, that's quite an assumption. We didn't manipulate his history."
"Is that so?"
"Don't you think it's rather rude to call for a meeting and then show such disrespect?"

"I don't think it's appropriate to hear this from those who broke the truce as soon as I finished my training and returned to my house. I understand the pain of having lost a lot of power without achieving what you had hoped for in this round, Ghost Chief."
"Ha, the audacity..."
Octavia had been displeased from the very beginning with Jin's unilateral announcement.
From her perspective, even if Zipfel had suffered a blow, they weren't a clan that Tikan could order around.
Let alone such rudeness. Even Hedo, who usually regarded Octavia and Kadun's strange attitudes (especially when dealing with Jin) with contempt, understood her reaction this time.
However, understanding was separate from needing to intervene.
So, just as Hedo and Ronil were about to step in, Orgal opened his mouth first.
"To restore my power and use me to deal with Rosa... That's a rather amusing thought. But, Jin. Aren't you underestimating me a bit too much?"
Orgal glanced at the Zipfel side. His face was blurry and not clearly visible, but he seemed to be smiling.

"Zipfel as they are now have not manipulated my history. That's an impossible task. It was the Zipfel of the past that bound me, and they don't possess the authority over the magic they unfolded. So it would be best to give up on that approach."
"No authority?"
"That's right. Even the current Zipfel would rather set me free. Unlike Rosa Runcandel, who is no different from the king of the Black Sea, at least I'm capable of conversation."
This was new information.
Octavia clenched her teeth as if humiliated. Jin made eye contact with Ronil.
"Is this true?"
It seemed to be.
But the possibility of it being false couldn't be completely ruled out.
Either Zipfel and Kinzelo had met first and agreed that the method wouldn't work, or Zipfel was hiding a possible truth.
"......Yes, 12th Knight. So it would be good not to provoke the Ghost Chief anymore. After all, didn't we meet to devise a countermeasure, as the Ghost Chief said?"
However, Jin had a way to verify whether their words were true or not.
"Well, it seems I might have been a bit too much. I'm sorry, you've come a long way. Please come in, let's share a meal and conversation."
"Thank you, 12th Knight."
"But there's something I should tell you first. In the spirit of hoping we all speak without a hint of deceit......"
Jin slowly looked around at the people.

"Today's meeting will include the contractor of Azmil. The contractor of Azmil will personally review all conversations, and all content will be recorded. If you do not agree to this, the meeting will be considered void."
